notes.title: Patch #14: Rainbow Decrees, Nothing Makeover, QoL!
notes.notes:
[p]This is a very cool patch that will help us strengthen the foundations of 9 Kings. Our three main topics: [b]Decrees[/b], the [b]King Of Nothing,[/b] and [b]performance[/b]. We heard your feedback, took notes on what's been fun, and with your help we believe our first patch after the biggest patch ever will also be a big deal.
[/p][p]The headline: we're bringing [b]15 new decrees (!!!) [/b]to the game and [b]a new decree tier [/b]altogether. King of Nothing is getting very needed improvements and new mechanics. And the game's performance should be tighter than ever.
[/p][h2][b]List of changes (0.8.11):[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Nothing Makeover![/b][/h3][p]It was also time to give [b]King of Nothing[/b] some well-deserved love. 9 Kings is growing fast, and the least we could do is give him [b]his own pool of decrees[/b]. [b]Soldiers[/b] and [b]Paladins[/b] now have special effects. And [b]Archers[/b] and [b]Castles[/b] got crazy unique decrees. Spoilers: you can shoot [b]double (or quintuple?) arrows[/b]. You can now throw [b]flaming boulders[/b]. And much more. We hope you'll stop ranking one of our fav kings in the lowest tiers now >:(. Every king shall be S-Tier one day![/p][list][*][p][b]Soldier[/b] now gets [b]+1% damage for every unit added[/b] to the troop.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Paladin[/b] now gets an [b]HP boost for every DMG boost it gets[/b]. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Decree: Fireball[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Decree: Twinshot[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Decree: Freshmen[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Decree: Armory[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Decree: Development
[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Rainbow decrees![/b] [/h3][p]Enter [b]a new kind of decree [/b]that will add a new gameplay layer to your runs. We're talking about game changing effects with diverse trade-offs, like [b]Gambling [/b](which now also belongs to this new category). Rainbow decrees can appear at any Royal Council event. We're starting with a total of 5 unique ones. More to come soon![/p][list][*][p][b]Decree: Longtermism[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Decree: Wishing Well[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Decree: Refraction[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Decree: Payroll[/b][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Universal decrees[/b][/h3][p]Following the pattern of the new perk system, classic decrees you're already familiar with are now called [b]Universal decrees[/b]. And we're also adding more of those! [/p][list][*][p][b]Decree: Rebirth[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Decree: Catharsis[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Decree: Weakspot[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Decree: Supplies[/b][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Performance[/b][/h3][p]This is also a VERY meaningful part of this patch. We had a bunch of performance improvements lined up but rolling them out in the same patch as the King of Nomads could've been a bit too risky. So now it's time! The game should be more optimized than ever and hopefully we'll hear less and less about crashes. Please keep us posted. This is still a work in progress.[/p][list][*][p]Improved spell attacks performance during battle (i.e [b]Static[/b], [b]Combustion[/b]).   [/p][/*][*][p]Improved high unit count processing performance.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved stat application cycle performance (you should feel the difference specially when playing late game[b] buff-heavy builds[/b], like [b]Lab Rat/Reinforce[/b] builds).[/p][/*][*][p][i]UP NEXT: a solution for the attack speed cap on crazy high speed builds. We'll talk more about this soon.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]QoL/Balancing/Fixes[/b][/h3][p]Thanks to your reports, we were also able to spot new bugs and address balancing/QoL issues.[/p][list][*][p][b]Move Speed[/b] is now shown on plot tooltips.[/p][/*][*][p]Tooltip visuals/colors improved for readability.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stat buffs[/b] are now visually displayed when you get a decree.[/p][/*][*][p]Subtly nerfed [u][b]enemy[/b][/u] [b]Defender.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Spores[/b] now properly attack in the first year after loading a game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Spores[/b] now work properly after [b]Migrating[/b] a [b]Mycelium[/b] plot.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an exploit that doubled your [b]Mob[/b] count every time you loaded the game with [b]Populate[/b] decree.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pagoda's Imps[/b] now properly target the closest enemy again.  [/p][/*][/list][p]
As always, after downloading the patch, [b]please start a new run[/b], as your previous run won’t have the updates stored and they may cause conflicts. If you experience any issues, please email us at [url="https://report@sadsocket.com"]report@sadsocket.com[/url].[/p][p][/p][h3]Steam Reviews: Your Feedback Matters[/h3][p]We've been reading through all your Steam reviews, and we appreciate the feedback we've been receiving. We'd love to continue seeing more of your thoughts! It helps us know what to focus on for each upcoming patch.  [/p][p][/p][p]Please join us on [url="https://discord.gg/VQwqwaH5Y3"]Discord[/url] and [url="https://www.reddit.com/r/9Kings/"]Reddit[/url]. You can also find the 9 Kings [url="https://wiki.hoodedhorse.com/9_Kings/Main_Page"]wiki[/url] page here for information on the game! [/p]

Love,
Sad Socket Team

notes.title: Patch #13: King of Nomads (New cards, perks, decrees, visuals & audio system)
notes.notes:
[p]This is a moment we're all waiting for. It's our biggest patch yet, our shift to [b]0.8[/b], and most importantly: it's time to introduce you to the [b]King of Nomads[/b]. 
[/p][previewyoutube="83jNgbeu-YA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]Who is the King of Nomads?[/h3][p]Taking over the barren snowy fields of the north, the reptilian nomad army belongs to nobody and no land. Their fierce warriors will pillage the other kingdoms while their steed tramples their armies.  TL;DR: Get ready for a ruthless winter, lizards, dragons, and a bit of good old Khan destructive energy.  [/p][p]   [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897639/363636476fa8be128d8de16f0aa0842566f3707b.png"][/img][/p][h3]A deck of movement[/h3][p]With the King of Nomads, we're adding an important layer of movement to the game. It's a deck that enables you to reshuffle your board, rewards placement & displacement of plots, and encourages you to experiment more with the dynamic nature of the game. We've been tracking everything that's missing from the current core gameplay so that we can address them at every new card added, [b]The King of[/b] [b]Nomads[/b] is coming in to fill some of these core spaces.[/p][p][/p][h3]The nomadic spells[/h3][p]You've asked for it: [b]Migration[/b] is a powerful card that will finally allow you to move your plots. This mechanic adds dozens of new possibilities to the game - including moving your base around! Of course, in a challenging way. [b]Swords[/b] and [b]Shields[/b] are simple yet key cards we've been missing for a very long time, and that will encourage new strategies both in early and late game plays. Plus you can also freeze your opponents now with the [b]Frost[/b] enchantment.[/p][p][/p][h3]The troops[/h3][p]We're introducing a solid mix of new troops to synergize with everything else that's already on the table. [b]Raptor[/b] is the first card that actually changes other troop's combat behavior, while [b]Mob[/b] introduces a very ambitions playstyle. Last but not least: yes, the Nomads base card, [b]Warlord[/b], is also a troop. We hope you have some fun with it.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897639/9ea3b60e6c4fab53ff2b75b4a29f65ef0b32dd69.png"][/img][/p][h3]No buildings?[/h3][p]King of Nomads has a troop-focused deck. However, the deck does have two building cards that create synergies with the movement-focused mechanics. [b]Camp[/b] card is an incredibly powerful building that encourages you to place new cards in your kingdom. [b]Dragon's Den[/b] is an epic summoning building that thrives on destruction. Occupy new plots, let go of old ones: this is the king of ephemeral. 
[/p][h3]Perks and decrees[/h3][p]The King of Nomads introduces, initially, 5 new decrees and 9 unique perks. They bring new mechanics to the table, which will result in new ways to break the game... which will result in some more healthy headaches for us devs.
[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897639/b8e9fbe5a9cc68b4b76fe08edc89bc2935457172.png"][/img][/p][h3]The design behind the king[/h3][p]The King of Nomads, much like the King of Time, is coming to the game to fill a few spaces we've always planned to fill. Allowing you to move your plots around changes the game completely. You can alternate buffs across a single run, change your strategy in the middle of the game, and make powerful new combos. Even Blessings become more relevant and viable with that card on the table. 

Design wise, we want you to feel like you can create a massive domino effect by synergizing all your right choices in a run. In that sense, a card that rewards destroying plots was also long due. Dragon's Den helps us start making sure that destroying plots unfolds in multiple new strats beyond the effect of a destruction card itself. 

Simple cards like Swords and Shields were also very necessary additions to the mix: the intentional simplicity behind them is key to open new fun strategies and complex ones alike. 

Last but not least... a base that's a troop is something we wanted in the game from day 1. And depending on how this goes, it might open new routes of experimentation for our current base cards as well. We're stoked that Warlord is finally here!

Anyway, we're already giving a lot of spoilers here. We can't wait for you to try the king out yourself and see everything else you can do with his deck, decrees, and perks.  [/p][p][/p][h3]Patch summary:[/h3][list][*][p]NEW KING: [b]King of Nomads[/b][/p][/*][*][p]NEW CARDS (9): [b]Warlord, Mob, Raptor, Dragon's Den, Camp, Frost, Swords, Shields, Migration[/b][/p][/*][*][p]NEW PERKS (9): [b]Immigrant, Reptilian, Jurassic, Leader, Aggressive, Defensive, Khan, Cold, Rebellious[/b][/p][/*][*][p]NEW DECREES (5): [b]Pillage, Smithy, Frostbite, Cryoflame, Settlement[/b][/p][/*][*][p]NEW ACHIEVEMENTS (3): [b]Double Double Double Dragon, Mass Migration, Mountception[/b][/p][/*][*][p]New battlefield[/p][/*][*][p]Custom king background visuals[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Several other improvements: [/h3][p]Our core focus in July was the King of Nomads. But, as always, we're also addressing your feedback in this patch. Here are the other [b]0.8.0 [/b]updates:
[/p][list][*][p]Overhauled audio system to prevent volume bursts and SFX distortion.[/p][/*][*][p]All kings got custom background visuals![/p][/*][*][p]Base cards can now be moved.[/p][/*][*][p]King Selection will now always start on your latest played king.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Crownmaxxing[/b] achievement is now triggered when you breeze through level 9 straight to level 10.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Midas Touch[/b] now works with [b]Bomber [/b]and all other explosive attacks.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Compendium[/b] [b]screen[/b] now has UI animations and can be navigated with controller/keyboard.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Converter[/b] plot damage now also displays the damage caused by its insta-kills.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mycelium[/b] created from [b]Pollinator[/b] perk can now start on level 4.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused loaded games to restart on year 1 with a random card. Shout out to our Discord community for figuring this one out (the culprit was Cloned cards)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that randomly caused "ghost [b]Boars[/b]" to get stuck on their plots.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where [b]Summoner[/b] perk and [b]Warhorns [/b]decree were giving 100% critical chance to target troops.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused [b]Warden[/b] perk to give your Stronghold +1 level every time you loaded a game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an exploit that allowed players to gain XP multiple times in year 99.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a lingering blurred screen when quitting the game in year 99.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed cursor attack preview area size. It's now properly synced with the actual effect area.[/p][/*][*][p]New audio effects implemented.[/p][/*][*][p]Battle pop-ups now fade faster to improve combat visibility.[/p][/*][*][p]VSync preferences are now stored in between game sessions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the scrolling of the language selection dropdown in the options screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed soundtrack issues after "Chaos Up" screens in Endless Mode[/p][/*][*][p]Animation-related performance improvements.[/p][/*][*][p]Localization fixes[/p][/*][/list][p]
You can expect a follow-up patch addressing your feedback very soon. Not to mention the new content that's already in the oven.[/p][p][/p][h3]Hotfixes ([b]0.8.04[/b]):[/h3][list][*][p][b]Demon's Altar[/b] no longer has its stats erased when [b]Migrated[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Swords[/b] no longer cause [b]Defenders[/b] damage to go NaN.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Overwork[/b] now properly works with [b]Camp.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Camp [/b]now works with [b]Migration, Echoform, [/b]and [b]Slime.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Pop-ups now properly display [b]Smithy[/b] stat bonus.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Warlord[/b] is no longer destroyed by [b]Unify.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed immortal frozen [b]Raptors.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Mothership[/b] now properly moves with [b]Migration [/b](shoutout to anyone who saw our infamous vending machine placeholder asset)[/p][/*][*][p]Critical buff is now properly applied by [b]Camp[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dragons[/b] now properly apply [b]poison[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Eyeglass[/b] now properly applies critical effect.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dragons[/b] with [b]Cryoflame[/b] will only fly around during battle.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quarry[/b] now works with [b]Warlord.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a glitch with Pagoda's Imps targeting behavior.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused units to stand still when you only have a [b]Demon's Altar[/b] on the field.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Steam Reviews: Your Feedback Matters[/h3][p]We've been reading through all your Steam reviews, and we appreciate the feedback we've been receiving. It's really important to us! Please continue sharing your thoughts, so we can know to focus on for each upcoming patch and make 9 Kings the best game it can be.  [/p][p][/p][p]After downloading the patch, [b]please start a new run[/b], as your previous run won’t have the updates stored and they may cause conflicts. If you experience any issues, please email us at [url="https://report@sadsocket.com"]report@sadsocket.com[/url].  [/p][p] [/p][p]Please join us on [url="https://discord.gg/VQwqwaH5Y3"]Discord[/url] and [url="https://www.reddit.com/r/9Kings/"]Reddit[/url]. You can also find the 9 Kings [url="https://wiki.hoodedhorse.com/9_Kings/Main_Page"]wiki[/url] page here for information on the game!  Love, Sad Socket team

Love,
Sad Socket team[/p]

notes.title: Patch #12: New Rainbow Perk, Buffs, VSync, Misclick Prevention & Fixes
notes.notes:
[p]In this patch, you can max your perks BEYOND level 3, finally enjoy VSync, and take dozens of buffed cards and perks for a spin.[/p][p]
We've been super stoked to see all the positive feedback around the new perk system. But of course, there are also issues we want to address and with your help we'll make things just right. As we mentioned before, a revamp changes a lot of things. And we're now starting to tweak those that need to be tweaked. We also took the time to buff some [i]ugly ducklings[/i] all over the game. Our ultimate goal is to make every king, card, decree, and perk equally relevant or die trying.[/p][p][/p][h3]List of changes ([b]0.7.94[/b]):[/h3][p][/p][p][b]NEW FEATURES:[/b][/p][list][*][p]NEW RAINBOW PERK: [b]Nationalist[/b] [i](All adjacent [b]king[/b] perks are applied +1 time)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]The game now supports [b]VSync[/b] (toggle it on in the options menu)![/p][/*][*][p]Misclick prevention: if you click the wrong card and move your mouse away, while still holding the button, the selection won't compute (finally!)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]BALANCING/FIXES:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]King I difficulty[/b] was attenuated (enemy stats will now scale a little bit slower)[/p][/*][*][p]Base cards gained a small initial stat buff to improve early run balancing.[/p][/*][*][p]Base cards now get a little attack speed boost when leveled up.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Vampirism[/b] enchantment now properly works with [b]all troops[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Echoform[/b] and [b]Slime [/b]now properly load very high stats when duplicated.[/p][/*][*][p]Very high stats are now properly loaded after saving & quitting (please start a new run)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Eyeglass[/b] decree now gives troops and towers 20% [b]raw[/b] critical chance.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bunker[/b] decree is now working properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Critical chance boosts now work with troops that had 0% critical chance.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Treant[/b] base initial damage was doubled. ːsteamthisː[/p][/*][*][p][b]Trapper[/b] troop was considerably buffed. ːsteamthisː[/p][/*][*][p][b]Imp [/b]troop[b] [/b]damage was buffed. ːsteamthisː[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mangler[/b] tower attack speed & level up stats were buffed. ːsteamthisː[/p][/*][*][p][b]Archer[/b] troop attack speed & level up stats were buffed. ːsteamthisː[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Hunter[/b] perk now gives [b]Trappers[/b] +20% damage (was 10%) ːsteamthisː[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bellicist[/b] perk now gives troops +10% critical chance (was 5%) ːsteamthisː[/p][/*][*][p][b]Berserk[/b] perk now gives Nothing troops +10% attack speed (was 5%) ːsteamthisː[/p][/*][*][p][b]Recruit[/b] perk now gives [b]Soldier[/b] +10% to all stats (was 5%) ːsteamthisː[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sorcerous[/b] perk now gives [b]Warlock[/b] +20% attack area (was 10%) ːsteamthisː[/p][/*][*][p][b]Butcher[/b] perk now gives [b]Mangler[/b] +20% attack area (was 10%) ːsteamthisː[/p][/*][*][p][b]Explosive [/b]perk now gives [b]Bomber[/b] +20% attack damage (was 10%) ːsteamthisː[/p][/*][*][p][b]Goon[/b] perk now gives [b]Thieves[/b] +20% critical damage (was 10%). ːsteamthisː[/p][/*][*][p][b]Castellan[/b] perk is now working properly with [b]Pagoda[/b] and [b]Stronghold[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Admiral[/b] perk is now working properly.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]MISC:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Critical chance now displays "%" properly in the tooltip.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a small delay to the arrows from [b]Sentinel[/b] perk, making the doubling visually perceptible[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused a crash if you had [b]Warden[/b] perk level up your castle beyond max level.[/p][/*][*][p]Localization fixes in Ukrainian, Turkish, and Portuguese 
[/p][/*][/list][p][i]*Reminder: you'll unlock the 4th Rainbow perk by getting a king to level 12. If you're already past level 12, the perk will already be unlocked after downloading this patch.
[/i][/p][h3]Dev's note[/h3][p]
These tweaks are an important first step in this new journey of balancing. The new Rainbow perk ([b]Nationalist[/b]) is intended to add even more build options and address feedback from players who missed the ability to further boost individual perks. With this perk, the max number of points you can have on your board [b]more than doubles compared to the original system[/b], allowing you to max out key perks [b]BEYOND level 3[/b] while also encouraging strategic thinking to make the most out of your board.

You'll notice how ONE single Rainbow perk can exponentially increase your options, and hopefully understand why we're not throwing everything at you at once! For now, we feel we're getting to a sweet-spot of max perk points in a single board. The next perk addition will pivot from the additive-support formula and bring some game twisting mechanics to the table. 

It's also important to note that the more perks we add, the fewer "meta" strategies we want there to be in the game. Experimentation is the soul of 9 Kings and we want to make the perk system live up to that. 

Anyway: we'll keep tweaking numbers and trying to improve any system that might be feeling underwhelming compared to others. We started off with the least used perks from the current patch, but know that we'll consider revamping some entirely, while, of course, adding more.  [/p][p]
As always, after downloading the patch, [b]please start a new run[/b], as your previous run won’t have the updates stored and they may cause conflicts. If you experience any issues, please email us at [url="https://report@sadsocket.com"]report@sadsocket.com[/url].  [/p][p][/p][h3]Your feedback REALLY matters[/h3][p]As we always say: the reason the game is EA is so we can build it together. We're listening and improving every day. So if you're REALLY angry at us because of something we tweaked, we hope you give us your feedback and some time to address it before hating us forever (!!!). Change will always make some people happy and some people angry, but we promise you we'll keep chasing that sweet spot for everyone if you give them a shot! 
[/p][h3]Coming next[/h3][p]Expect more balancing and QoL updates in the upcoming days. The 8th king is coming soon![/p][p][/p][p]Please join us on [url="https://discord.gg/VQwqwaH5Y3"]Discord[/url] and [url="https://www.reddit.com/r/9Kings/"]Reddit[/url]. You can also find the 9 Kings [url="https://wiki.hoodedhorse.com/9_Kings/Main_Page"]wiki[/url] page here for information on the game!  Love, Sad Socket team

Love,
Sad Socket team[/p]

notes.title: Patch #11: Meta-progression Revamp
notes.notes:
[p]This patch might be the most meaningful one we've ever dropped. We listened closely to your feedback, banged our heads on the wall for a month to come up with the right solutions, and the result is a total revamp of the game's meta-progression system. [b]With 52 new perks for a total of over 80, [/b]and a huge design improvement. [/p][p][/p][h1]Perk System revamp [/h1][p][/p][h3]Dynamic perks[/h3][p]We're no longer locking you into pre-determined upgrades per king. [b]You now have 9 slots. And you can use them in whichever way you want.[/b] The idea is to bring the 9 Kings core design to the meta-progression system. It's a minimalistic dynamic version of the game loop you're here for. The new system can be approached casually if you just want to chill, but that can have a whole new level of depth if that's what you're into. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897639/f120ebc9797d8ac990deb301bf58ae0452163e25.png"][/img][/p][h3]80+ upgrades[/h3][p]You will now have a limitless pool of perks to choose from, and [b]they will be unlocked as you play the game[/b]. Some perks are universal, some are unique to your king, some are Rainbow perks. Think tactically and choose the best 9-combo for your strategy. We're starting with a total of [b]80+ unlockable perks [/b]and we'll keep adding more, and tweaking those that might not quite work yet.[/p][p][/p][h3]Rainbow perks![/h3][p]Rainbow perks will twist the game in interesting ways - including your own perk board (like [b]Expander[/b] in the screenshot). Once unlocked, a Rainbow perk can be used across all kings, like Universal perks. We'll start with 3 experimental Rainbow perks and we plan on expanding the pool very quickly.   [/p][p][/p][h3]Unique Nothing perks[/h3][p]By the way, old "Nothing" perks are now called Universal perks. This means that our dear King of Nothing now has his own unique perk pool like all the other kings.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897639/255d6153f713c21f67466d51d992f77e880a61b8.png"][/img][/p][h3]Level cap is gone[/h3][p]The 9-level cap is now gone. The community asked for it, and [b]you can now level up forever.[/b] Every time you level up, you'll unlock a new perk as long as there are perks available. After that, you can still brag about being level 999 to your friends. [b]The required XP to level up was also reduced by 25%. [/b][/p][p][/p][h3]A new perk every time you level up[/h3][p]If you're new to the game: you'll unlock a new perk, randomly, every time a king levels up. The unlock system will alternate between Universal and King perks. Every time you hit a level threshold for the first time (level 3, 6, 9, and so on), you will also unlock a Rainbow perk.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897639/6f15dfe7162a3dceb836b18b7643d73188bb7907.png"][/img][/p][h3]Early supporters in mind[/h3][p]If you're a veteran: those who've already played the game will start with one perk per level unlocked. [b]All the perks you know are still available [/b]to be unlocked. You'll also likely have more perks than you did before. With the Universal pool of perks, the idea is to make the game less grindy while still keeping things fresh with the king-specific perks.[/p][p][/p][h3]Difficulty Rebalancing[/h3][p]The game's core difficulties were rebalanced based on your feedback. On lower difficulties, first years got a little harder ([b]Peasant difficulty is now equivalent to Squire[/b], and so on). On the other hand, [b]Endless Mode difficulty progression curve is now 10% less steep [/b]on all difficulties. [b]King difficulty, the pure game experience,[/b] [b]remains with a similar scaling[/b], although you can now come up with more ways to beat it thanks to the new perk thresholds. It also means you can perceive the curve between difficulty levels with a bit more clarity (the gap between Prince and King being is now slightly smaller, for example) 
[/p][p]The best thing about this rebalancing is that we're aiming to address two things we've been hearing from you: on one hand, it can be a little too easy to beat the core game on lower difficulties. On the other hand, some people feel Endless Mode gets way too hard too fast. By making the first years subtly more challenging on lower difficulties, we came up with a new progression curve that makes Endless years a little less abrupt. Don't be mistaken though: we're talking about 10%. It's still exponential ruthlessness. We'll keep tweaking everything according to the community's experiences. We are listening![/p][p][/p][h3]An important disclaimer[/h3][p]It took us a while, but we feel we finally cracked a balance between abundance and limitation. We truly believe that what makes 9 Kings special is that it forces you to be creative with a finite amount of resources (the magic number 9). But the 9 on its own wouldn't be any fun if it didn't enable hundreds of creative outcomes. We also really dislike the idea of mindless meta-progression. We want to value your time and make you feel stimulated, while giving you more agency. With this new system, we hope you'll see the 9-grid as a fun challenge, something that encourages you to explore, be strategic, and find the most meaningful perk strategy for your style.
[/p][h1]Other Updates [/h1][p]As usual, here are the remaining updates of patch 0.7.91: [/p][list][*][p][b]X-Ray[/b] now works with base cards[/p][/*][*][p][b]Slime[/b] performance improvement[/p][/*][*][p]Duplicated units are no longer (wrongly) affected by [b]Populate[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Echoform/Slime[/b] will now properly duplicate extremely high stats (PENDING: HOTFIX INCOMING)[/p][/*][*][p]The game will now properly load extremely high stats (PENDING: HOTFIX INCOMING)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ruthless[/b] can no longer insta-kill bosses.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized Rainbow army shader[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dispenser[/b] projectiles are no longer underneath buildings (this dev wants to slap himself every time he sees a gameplay video of Dispensers in the last patch)[/p][/*][*][p]Perk art was updated[/p][/*][*][p]There's more coming very soon![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Don't forget to leave a Steam review[/h3][p]Anyway, we're very excited about this system and very eager to hear your thoughts. One of the biggest feedbacks we've got for 9 Kings was the lack of depth for the meta-progression system. And we agree! The game is in early access and hopefully we can keep building it together. We can't wait![/p][p][/p][p]Please join us on [url="https://discord.gg/VQwqwaH5Y3"]Discord[/url] and [url="https://www.reddit.com/r/9Kings/"]Reddit[/url]. You can also find the 9 Kings [url="https://wiki.hoodedhorse.com/9_Kings/Main_Page"]wiki[/url] page here for information on the game!  Love, Sad Socket team  Steam Reviews: Your Feedback Matters We've been reading through all your Steam reviews, and we appreciate the feedback we've been receiving. We'd love to continue seeing more of your thoughts! It helps us know what to focus on for each upcoming patch.    

Love, 
Sad Socket team[/p]

notes.title: Patch #07: Big Optimizations (pt. 1), Critical hits, Saving, Hotfixes
notes.notes:
Alright, this is the most important patch yet. 

We're working hard to live up to the expectations you have on us. And we hope you and the [b]250k+ (!!!)[/b] people playing enjoyed the first week of 9 Kings. In this patch, we're fixing key issues you reported, starting to implement the [b]first part[/b] of core performance tweaks, while also improving some core mechanics like the critical hits, late game damage processing, and the run saving system.

[h3]Steam Reviews: Your Feedback Matters[/h3]We've been reading through all of your Steam reviews and we appreciate all the feedback we've been getting. We'd love to continue seeing more of your thoughts! It helps us know what to focus on for each upcoming patch. 

List of changes ([b]0.7.44[/b]):

[b]Gameplay/QOL:[/b]
[*] Critical hits now are displayed in a cool orange color & exclamation marks (have fun, marksmen)
[*] Fixed a [b]Precision[/b] stacking glitch (sit back and watch things go POW POW POW POW)
[*] [b]Reinforce[/b] now shows consolidated stack damage increase numbers
[*] Fixed some key data storage variables when loading runs
[*] Fixed a glitch when quitting a game right before a battle starts (it no longer loads thinking you're in battle)
[*] Perks and Decrees are now applied correctly after loading a game
[*] Buffed initial [b]Palace[/b] attack speed (it's now 0.37/s, and it gets wild with level ups)
[*] Healing numbers are also hidden when "HIDE DAMAGE NUMBERS" option is toggled
[*] [b]Shrine[/b] now levels up a single plot per year and its effect costs less gold per level
[*] Fixed an exploit that allowed you to re-use razed tiles (from [b]Razing[/b]) with [b]Earthworks[/b] or the [b]Exploration[/b] decree (very nice catch, community)
[*] End screen stat numbers are now properly displayed after loading a run
[*] Fixed the apostrophe character in French

[b]Performance: [/b]
[*] Improved combat performance during late game for high attack speed builds
[*] Improved the way damage is computed per frame to mitigate overflow during battle
[*] Improved damage computing on Endless Mode (making it more viable to get to year 99)
[*] Improved level up processing mechanic ([b]Rats[/b] should crash less now when you domino the hell out of them)
[*] Optimized [b]Orchard[/b] performance
[*] Optimized Achievement detection performance
[*] Fixed small backend errors

[b]COMING NEXT:[/b]
[*] Animation system revamp (that will improve performance considerably)
[*] Improved attack speed processing during late late game.
[*] More balancing tweaks & fixes
[*] New content

After downloading the patch, [b]please start a new run[/b], as previous runs won’t have the updates stored and it may cause conflicts. If you experience any issues, please email us at report@sadsocket.com. We previously posted this patch yesterday but rolled back due to a gamebreaking bug found with [b]Trappers/Scapegoats.[/b] Sorry about that!

This update brings very big changes, and your feedback is very important. There are 250k computers running 9 Kings out there, and as much as we try to foresee as many issues as possible, some gaps will only become clear with your input. Optimizing 9 Kings is an ongoing task, and your help is vital to us. That’s why we chose to release the game in EA. We hope you understand and keep helping us build the best game we can.

You can also expect more performance patches and new content very soon!

Love,
Sad Socket team

[h3]Steam Reviews: Your Feedback Matters[/h3]We've been reading through all of your Steam reviews and we appreciate all the feedback we've been getting. We'd love to continue seeing more of your thoughts! It helps us know what to focus on for each upcoming patch. 

Here's the full list of changes ([b]0.7.30[/b]):

[*] Hot-fixed a glitch that caused [b]Converter[/b] to get INSANELY OP after the final boss.
[*] [b]Prophet[/b] now appears one year earlier
[*] First [b]Merchant[/b] now appears one year earlier
[*] First [b]Diplomat[/b] now appears one year earlier
[*] Improved [b]Splicing[/b] & [b]Gentrify[/b] performance
[*] [b]Concabulator[/b] now only levels up [b]one level[/b] of every unit, as originally intended. The megalomaniac Lab Rat domino effect still works normally in all usual situations.
[*] [b]Broken Cabulator[/b] is now a level 1 card (as originally intended)
[*] Made sure upgrade pop ups don't keep spamming, visually, forever (specially on Reinforce builds)
[*] Fixed a respawn issue that caused some [b]Boars[/b] to not leave their plots.
[*] You can no longer keep playing on Stats screen after ending a run during a battle

notes.title: Patch #02: Hotfixes, Performance, Balancing, Timer
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone! 

We've been super stoked about all the feedback we've been getting. Now, here comes a very important patch. Please keep your reviews coming, they're extremely helpful to us. 

We're working hard to fix all the unexpected bugs you've been reporting, and hopefully we'll address all of them in no time. We're also working hard to improve performance on late game and you can expect a dedicated performance patch soon. Thanks for all your support!

Here's the list of updates in [b]0.7.21[/b]:

[*] Localization improvements: We're currently investigating and working to fix problems with display of characters on certain systems, we have made some fixes and will keep working hard to resolve all issues as soon as possible! (对不起！另外也非常感谢玩家 Akelyds 花时间提供详细的反馈，帮我们一起排查这个问题。)

And that's it for day 2. We're rebalancing the game in real time as we gather feedback. Please keep it coming and know this is a work in progress. As you know, some decisions will be made with performance in mind, but we can tweak what's not working at any time, so please let us know your thoughts and leave us a review. 

Expect a substantial performance patch for Endless Mode soon!

Join us on [url=https://discord.gg/EXEBmsnEAv]Discord[/url], [url=https://t.co/KMb5PlerXg]Reddit[/url], and [url=https://x.com/SadSocketGames]Twitter[/url]

notes.title: [PATCH NOTE] 9 Kings 377
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone. We’re finally heading toward a demo version with a stable Endless Mode. There’s always room for improvement, but our focus is now shifting toward the Early Access release that’s just around the corner (make sure to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2784470/9_Kings/]wishlist[/url] 🙏). We can’t wait!

Anyway, massive performance improvements were necessary for this one. And here’s what’s new:
	
•	Heavily improved memory usage.
•	9 Kings went on a diet and now weighs less than half its original size in MBs!
•	Improved Endless scaling: early years are even easier, final years are [u]much[/u] harder.
•	Increased max enemy count (did I mention the final years are harder?)
•	The two points above mean the "canon gamebreaking year" has increased drastically.
•	Balancing: leveling up a troop will give you the same amount of extra units as the first card (i.e you will get 9 soldiers per level instead of 9-3-3)
•	Fixed the recurring bug that caused the game to soft lock during late game (this was a hard one, and the reason this patch took this long - please keep us posted!)
•	Fixed a glitch that caused towers’ attack speed stat to underperform.
•	Fixed a bug that caused Mangler to not be properly affected by DMG upgrades.
•	Russian is now available.
•	The game no longer slows down when you have no units (it's now a menu option!).
•	You can now disable blood particles (this is a family friendly kingdom!)
•	Improved card descriptions.
•	Improved fonts

We really hope the game runs smoother than ever on everyone’s computers. But please share your experience with us! Since this update drastically changes the way data is handled, we’ll be on the lookout for possible hot-fixes immediately.

Love,
Sad Socket team

notes.title: Demo 343 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Demo 343[/b] improves the game's performance on endless mode, rebalances some units and improves the game's localization.

[b]New Features:[/b]
- Game version is now shown on Main Menu.
- Added Japanese and Korean translation, and new fonts for Chinese.
- [b]Boar revamp:[/b] it now raises all rider's stats by 1% for each 1 HP the boar has and can only be mounted by adjacent units.

[b]Game Balancing:[/b]
- Scout Tower receives less attack speed and more attack power upon leveling up.
- Demon Altar's power stack % rebalanced.
- Mercenary stats improved, costs increased (as per build 342)

[b]QoL:[/b]
- Demon's Altar performance rework.
- Improved endless mode unit scaling.
- Bomber unit optimization.
- Spells have been separated into 2 categories: Enchantments (the ones that add effects to troops) and Tomes (the ones that can be used only once for an instant effect).

- Fixed a game breaking bug where players could place 2 castles after picking a King of Spells decree.
- Fixed the UI count for the amount of imps summoned by king of blood's castle.
- Fixed localization font glitches.
- Fixed King of Nature boss attacks (that made him practically immortal).
